questions.question: When Isaac asked his father Abraham where the lamb for the burnt offering was, what did Abraham answer?

answers.text: God Himself will provide the lamb
The servants will bring one up
We'll find one at the top

questions.question: When Abraham held the knife over his son Isaac on the altar, what did the angel of the LORD tell him?

answers.text: Do not lay a hand on the boy
Take the boy home with you

questions.question: After the angel stopped Abraham from harming his son Isaac, what did Abraham see in a thicket behind him?

answers.text: A ram caught by its horns
A goat tangled in the vines
A calf stuck in the brush

questions.question: After Abraham obeyed God and did not withhold Isaac, God promised that Abraham's descendants would be like what?

answers.text: The stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore
The fish in the sea and the birds in the air
The trees in the forest and the grass in the field
